title: Win flow and win panel
summary: WinDirector banks the win at the last move, plays the celebration, then the win panel (normal / Hard / Super Hard).
description: At the winning move the win is banked at once (Economy.finishAttempt), the board's clear wave and the celebration play (`FXEffect.celebration`: the win-celebration component's, through the FX host's registry), then WinPanel shows the reward (tier colours) with a strip under it — a slot (`PanelStrips`) the events fill: the Rocket Race bar, Up & Away's strip or the Streak Race strip. Continue -> home with the payout queue. Registered by WinFlowRegistration.swift.
notes: Without the win-celebration component the `.celebration` effect finishes at once (logged) and the panel follows; without events no strip is drawn.
